_comment: Manual corrections, applied last and always winning over the rules.
One entry per story id, as it appears in data/stories.json:
Hiding a story sets its status to hidden, which keeps it out of every
page and feed while leaving the record in place - so the next run does
not simply rediscover it and put it back.
Any other field replaces what the rules decided. Filling in a missing
city or type also promotes a story out of the review bucket.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored, so this comment is safe.
